critical_code_review_comments: concierge-fee/[dealId]/refund/route.ts: The refund clears feePaidAt (sets to null) instead of setting a feeRefundedAt field. This means the financial summary cannot track exact refund amounts separately — it uses AuditLog count as a workaround. Consider adding feeRefundedAt and feeRefundedAmountCents fields to the Deal model.
All 18 new admin endpoints correctly read amounts from lib/constants.ts (never from client input). DEPOSIT_AMOUNT_CENTS=9900 and PREMIUM_FEE_REMAINING_CENTS=40000 enforced server-side.
The deposit/[depositId]/refund route correctly handles both real Stripe intents (calls stripe.refunds.create) and admin-generated pi_admin_* intents (skips Stripe call). Good sandbox handling.
deals/[dealId]/action route uses DealStatus enum validation before updating — valid stage transitions enforced. DEAL_STAGE_ADVANCED action works for any target status in the enum.
